VAR_000171 at 508: F missing (no alternative sequence); in CF and CBAVD; most common mutation in Caucasian CF chromosomes; impairs protein folding and stability; causes local changes to the surface that mediates interactions between domains; decreases frequency of channel opening in vitro; binds to the cytokeratin-8 and through this binding is primed for the degradation pathway that ends in the proteasome thus impairing trafficking; impairs maturation and trafficking to the cell membrane; impairs recycling to the cell membrane after endocytosis; abolishes MARCHF2-mediated degradation; dbSNP:rs121909001 and dbSNP:rs113993960
